description: Get ready for the biggest, boldest, most unforgettable night on campus, Songfest is back! This year’s Songfest theme is “Wrapped,” inspired by the end-of-year music recap experience made popular by Spotify Wrapped. Groups are encouraged to create a performance that feels like a personalized music recap, highlighting songs, artists, trends, moments, or musical eras that defined the year. Your performance can tell a story, showcase a collection of songs, or take the audience through different “categories” of your own Wrapped experience. This event is coordinated by Student Engagement & Belonging. For questions about this event, please call (316) 978-3022 or email greeklife@wichita.edu . To learn more about Fraternity and Sorority Life at Wichita State, visit www.wichita.edu/fsl .

This session is all about chapter culture and ensuring your brotherhood/sisterhood can withstand anything. Strong brotherhood and sisterhood go beyond group chats, chapter meetings, and social events! In this interactive workshop, fraternity and sorority leaders will explore what it takes to build genuine connections, create a healthy chapter culture, and keep members engaged throughout their membership experience. Through honest conversations, creative challenges, and collaborative activities, you'll evaluate your chapter's strengths, identify opportunities for growth, and discover simple ways to strengthen relationships without breaking the budget. Walk away with fresh ideas and a Chapter Connection Challenge you can put into action within 30 days!
